data.title: Hallador Energy Receives Regulatory Approval for $1B, 12-Year Capacity Sale
data.description:
Hallador Energy Company () (“Hallador” or the “Company”), a vertically integrated independent power producer, today announced that the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission has approved its previously announced 12-year capacity agreement with a subsidiary of a utility. The Commission’s order, issued on November 18, 2026, satisfies the regulatory approval condition to the agreement, which is now effective.

The agreement, entered into on May 1, 2026, and announced on May 6, 2026, is expected to generate more than $1 billion in capacity revenue from the Company’s Merom Generating Station through mid-2040. Priced at more than twice Hallador’s historical capacity pricing, the agreement nearly doubled Hallador’s forward sales book when announced in May. Subsequent agreements have increased the Company’s total forward sales book to approximately $3 billion.

“This contract provides a long-term source of revenue at more than twice Hallador's historical capacity pricing,” said Brent Bilsland, President and Chief Executive Officer of Hallador. “It allows us to retain the ability to sell Merom’s energy separately, and earn additional revenue from the power the plant produces.”

Deliveries begin with a smaller volume of accredited capacity in late 2028, increasing to approximately two-thirds of the Company’s accredited capacity beginning in 2029 and continuing through the end of the term. The capacity price remains fixed throughout the 12-year term.

Capacity payments compensate Hallador for keeping power generation capability available to meet demand. The agreement is capacity-only and does not include the sale of energy.

“We’ve put long-term contracts in place and made significant progress on our plans to grow our power business,” said Bilsland. “This approval demonstrates that Indiana’s Regulators are still supporting the growth of data centers in Indiana.”

About Hallador Energy Company

Hallador Energy Company () is a vertically integrated independent power producer based in Terre Haute, Indiana. The Company has two core businesses: Hallador Power Company, LLC, which produces electricity and provides accredited capacity at its one-gigawatt Merom Generating Station, and Sunrise Coal, LLC, which produces and supplies fuel to Merom and other companies. For more information, visit www.halladorenergy.com.

Forward-Looking Statements

These statements are based on current expectations and assumptions and involve risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. These risks include risks relating to the effectiveness and potential termination of the agreement (including termination rights upon a change in law or repeated shortfalls in capacity deliveries), Hallador’s obligations to provide replacement capacity or pay damages for any shortfall and to post performance security, restrictions on certain ownership changes and asset transfers, the risk that the Commission’s order approving the agreement is subject to rehearing, appeal or other challenge, Merom’s availability, reliability and accredited capacity (including changes to the accreditation methodologies and market rules of the Midcontinent Independent System Operator), Hallador’s ability to sell Merom’s energy separately and the prices realized, Hallador’s ability to execute its growth plans and long-term strategy, and the risk that revenue realized under the agreement may be materially lower than the amounts disclosed, as well as the risks described in Hallador’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, Hallador’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and other filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission. data.title: CBOT wheat rises on Black Sea export worries
data.description:
Chicago Board of Trade wheat futures rebounded from a multi-month low on Thursday as a lack of diplomatic progress towards de-escalation in Russia's war in Ukraine elevated worries about Black Sea shipments, analysts said.

  • Russian President Vladimir Putin ruled out negotiations for a Black Sea ceasefire after Ukraine destroyed part of a bridge linking Russia to Crimea.

  • The International Grains Council raised its forecast for 2026/27 global wheat production by 6 million metric tons to 826 million tons, it said on Thursday.

  • The US Department of Agriculture reported net export sales of US wheat in the week ended November 12 at 344,800 metric tons in the current marketing year, within a range of trade expectations for 200,000 to 400,000 tons.

  • CBOT December soft red winter wheat settled 8-1/4 cents higher at $5.78-1/4 per bushel after dipping to $5.65-1/4, the contract's lowest since January.

  • K.C. December hard red winter wheat (KWZ26) last traded up 17-3/4 cents at $6.27 a bushel.

  • Minneapolis December spring wheat (MWEZ26) rose 13 cents to end at $6.41-1/2 a bushel.

data.title: Endava Receives Notice from NYSE Regarding Delayed Filing of Annual Report on Form 20-F
data.description:
Endava plc () (“Endava” or the “Company”) today announced that it received a notice from the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) on November 18, 2026 stating that the Company is not in compliance with the NYSE’s continued listing requirements under Section 802.01E of the NYSE Listed Company Manual as a result of the Company’s delay in filing its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (the “Annual Report”) with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”).

The notice has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the Company’s securities on the NYSE subject to the Company’s compliance with other continued listing requirements.

As previously disclosed in a Form 12b-25 filed by the Company on November 3, 2026, the Company was unable, without unreasonable effort or expense, to file the Annual Report within the prescribed time period due to the internal investigation initiated by the Company’s Audit Committee into the accounting treatment of certain customer and supplier agreements. As a result of the investigation and the identification of separate accounting errors relating to revenue recognition, the Company is in the process of restating its previously reported financial results for fiscal 2026.

The Company’s preliminary estimate of the restatement’s impact on the Company’s previously reported fiscal 2026 financial results, its disclosure controls and procedures, and its internal control over financial reporting remains consistent with its press release issued on October 28, 2026. Endava expects adjustments to its fiscal 2026 revenue to be equivalent to approximately 2% – 4% of the Company’s fiscal 2025 revenue, it does not expect any adjustments to its fiscal 2025 results, and it does not expect a restatement of prior fiscal years or previous periods relating to those prior fiscal years. Management is currently in discussions with its lenders as it evaluates these matters and the potential impact on the Company’s revolving credit facility.

Under NYSE rules, Endava has a six-month period from the filing due date of November 17, 2026 to file the Annual Report with the SEC and regain compliance. The Company continues to work diligently with its advisors and auditors to file the Annual Report as soon as reasonably practicable and regain compliance with the NYSE’s continued listing requirements.

About Endava

Endava is a leading provider of next-generation technology services dedicated to enabling its clients to accelerate growth, tackle complex challenges and thrive in evolving markets. Endava embeds AI across the design and delivery of technology transformation, combining it with deep industry expertise to deliver measurable client outcomes with greater speed and precision. Central to Endava’s model is Dava.Flow™, its AI-native engagement lifecycle with governance, traceability and transparency built into the delivery process.

Endava’s clients span payments, insurance, banking and capital markets, technology, media, telecommunications, healthcare, mobility, retail and consumer goods and more. The Company’s team of more than 10,000 Endavans helps clients break new ground from locations in Europe, the Americas, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.

For more information, visit www.endava.com.
